## Problem 1: NY NOAA

### Load `ny_noaa` Dataset

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

### Data Description

The `ny_noaa` dataset provides information on weather data in New York. Each observation represents each day from `r min(pull(ny_noaa, date))` to `r max(pull(ny_noaa, date))`, resulting in `r nrow(ny_noaa)` total observations. There are `r ncol(ny_noaa)` variables in the dataset, including the weather station ID (`id`), daily precipitation (`prcp`), daily snowfall (`snow`), daily snow depth (`snwd`), and maximum and minimum daily temperature (`tmax`, `tmin`). Among all observation in the dataset, there is `r ((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, id))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100`% and `r ((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, date))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100`% missing data in regards to weather station ID (`id`) and date (`date`) of observation, respectively. However, there is more extensive missing data in regard to the other weather-related values. Specifically, among all observations in the `ny_noaa` dataset `r round(((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, prcp))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100, 2)`% of precipitation (`prcp`) data is missing, `r round(((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, snow))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100, 2)`% of snowfall (`snow`) data is missing, `r round(((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, snwd))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100, 2)`% of snow depth (`snwd`) data is missing, `r round(((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, tmax))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100, 2)`% of maximum temperature (`tmax`) data is missing, and `r round(((sum(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, tmin))))/(nrow(ny_noaa)))*100, 2)`% of minimum temperature (`tmin`) data is missing.
